svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four 258 long from M5 A4 threaded rod; chamfer and dress

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both ends so a nut runs on by hand.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One end goes 12 into the lower cap's tapped holes with a drop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of medium threadlocker; run it in with two nuts locked

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The other end passes through the upper cap and carries a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm washer and an M5 acorn nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tighten the four acorn nuts evenly, a quarter turn at a time,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: until both tube ends are down on their seats, then to about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 N m. Do not over-tighten: the upper cap is acetal.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: all four studs stand 246 above the lower cap's top face.
